You're on the list.

Thanks for joining the Datum Strength waitlist.

Datum is automated tracking and reporting for strength training. Your sets and reps are logged for you, with nothing typed. Your reports cover bar speed, depth, grinds, best reps, estimated max and your history.

What to expect
We'll email you when there is something for you to do, like setting Datum up at your gym or on your own rack. We won't send much in between.

In the meantime
Follow @datumstrength, where we post real sets and what the reports say about them.
